description.text: International Economics and Trade is an interdisciplinary subject that focuses on global resource allocation, cross-border trade rules and cross-border business operations, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as economics, international trade practice, international commercial law, foreign languages and information technology. This major, against the backdrop of "globalization", studies the flow patterns of goods, services and capital among countries, and aims to cultivate compound talents with an international perspective, cross-cultural communication skills and practical operation skills. It is dedicated to solving practical problems such as international trade frictions, cross-border supply chain management and international market expansion.

duration.text: The International economics and trade at Northwestern Polytechnical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. A scanned copy of the valid and clear information page of the passportThe passport is valid until October 30, 2025 and beyond. Applicants currently residing in the Chinese mainland must also provide a scanned copy of the current valid visa page or residence permit page.2 Scanned copy of high school graduation certificateIf the applicant is a current student, they must submit a certificate of enrollment issued by their school, which includes the expected graduation date, and submit the graduation certificate before registration.3 Scanned copies of the transcripts for each semester/academic year during high schoolIf the applicant has not completed the previous stage of study, they must provide transcripts for all semesters up to the time of application.4 Personal statement (template), resume5 Scanned copy of the Chinese/English language proficiency certificateApplicants who meet the following conditions are not required to provide proof of language proficiencyApplicants whose native language is Chinese are applying for programs taught in Chinese.Applicants whose native language is English are applying for English-taught programs.6 Scanned copy of the certificate of no criminal record (valid within 6 months)Currently residing within the territory of Chinese mainland, one must simultaneously submit a criminal record clearance certificate from both the home country and the period of stay in China.If you are temporarily unable to provide a certificate of no criminal record due to various special circumstances, please fill out the "Personal Commitment Letter". After being tentatively admitted, you must submit the certificate of no criminal record as soon as possible. Only after submitting it can you obtain the admission qualification.7 Scanned copies of officially certified awards and research achievements (not mandatory)8 Scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid within 6 months)Those currently residing in the Chinese mainland and holding a valid "Foreigner's Residence Permit" or "Foreigner's Permanent Residence Identity Card" may use either of the above materials to replace the "Foreigner's Physical Examination Form".9 As of November 1, 2025, applicants under the age of 18 must provide a minor guarantee letter (template).10. Bank statements of the account of myself or my parents for the past six months (with a balance of no less than 5,000 US dollars).11. Other supplementary materials required to be submitted by Northwestern Polytechnical University.

requirements.text: 1. Health conditionGood physical and mental health (free from infectious diseases and physical or mental disorders that may affect normal study).2 Age requirementAs of September 1, 2025, applicants must not exceed 25 years old.3 Educational requirementsBy September 1, 2025, applicants must have obtained a high school graduation certificate.4 Learning abilityApplicants should possess good learning ability and academic performance. The score requirement for applicants of the undergraduate program in the previous application stage is 75%. Schools refer to the results of internationally recognized standardized tests such as SAT, ACT, A-Level, AP, IB, and GED, or regional high school unified examinations. Applicants may provide proof of other learning abilities or academic performance.5 Language requirementsApplicants should have a language proficiency in Chinese or English that meets the admission standards. In some countries, the proof of English proficiency may be waived (information on English-speaking countries).
